CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS translation ( id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), word_id uuid NOT NULL, translation VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (word_id) REFERENCES word_eng (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE, UNIQUE (translation) );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS card ( id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), word_id uuid NOT NULL, translation_id uuid NOT NULL, transcription_id uuid, audio_id uuid, CONSTRAINT card_unique UNIQUE (word_id, transcription_id, audio_id), FOREIGN KEY (word_id) REFERENCES word_eng (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (audio_id) REFERENCES audio (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (transcription_id) REFERENCES transcription (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (translation_id) REFERENCES translation (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE );
